title: Jones out with an adductor strain, and Parma visit Saturday
description: Cristian Chivu meets reporters at 8:30 AM ET, and the club says San Siro is close to selling out for Saturday's visit of Parma.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 38, Friday, October 9, 2026 — Jones out with an adductor strain, and Parma visit Saturday

blocks.html: Curtis Jones, the midfielder, has a strain in the adductor muscles of his right thigh. Inter gave no return date, and Sky Sport Italia reports three to four weeks. Cristian Chivu, Inter's head coach, meets reporters this morning at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, a day before Parma visit a San Siro that is close to selling out.

blocks.h3: Inter say Jones has a strain in his right adductors
paras: Curtis Jones had tests on Thursday morning at the Humanitas Research Hospital in Rozzano, south of Milan. The club said they found a myofascial strain in the adductor muscles of his right thigh.
Inter set no return date, saying only he will be reassessed in the coming days.

blocks.h3: Parma on Saturday, with San Siro close to selling out
paras: Kevin Bonacina, a referee from the Bergamo section, will referee Saturday's match, with Gianluca Manganiello as fourth official and Daniele Paterna on VAR. Gates open at 10:00 AM ET, 16:00 CEST, with the remaining tickets in a resale for season ticket holders.

Inter have not lost to Parma in their last nine league meetings, and Marcus Thuram, the forward, has scored in each of his four Serie A matches against them. The guide has Parma 15th with four points.

blocks.h3: Genoa in the Coppa Italia on December 1, and tickets open today
paras: Inter, who hold the cup, play Genoa at San Siro in the round of 16 on Tuesday, December 1 at 3:00 PM ET, 21:00 CET. It is one match, not two legs.
PLUS season ticket holders can confirm a seat for €1 from 6:00 AM ET today, 12:00 CEST, until 5:59 PM ET on Sunday. The general sale opens at 6:00 AM ET on Monday, 12:00 CEST.

blocks.h3: Sky Sport Italia: three to four weeks for Jones, and Barella starts
paras: Sky Sport Italia reports through FCInterNews that Jones is out for three to four weeks. He is aiming for the home match against Como, the last before the November international break. Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy's biggest sports daily, reads it as about 20 days, with Venezia on October 28 or the derby on October 31 as the target.

Sky says Inter's midfield re-forms around three. Nicolò Barella is ready to start against Parma, with Henrikh Mkhitaryan beside him, and Hakan Calhanoglu is available again after the problem that kept him out before Udinese.
blocks.kicker: SKY SPORT ITALIA VIA FCINTERNEWS · OCT 8

blocks.h3: Corriere dello Sport: English interest in Sucic, and a raise to discuss
paras: Corriere dello Sport reports through FCInterNews that English clubs have begun to ask about Petar Sucic, the midfielder, and that Inter are not entertaining a sale. His representatives want to talk about a raise, and Dario Baccin, Inter's deputy sporting director, has kept a slot for them.
Fabrizio Romano, the transfer reporter, wrote on Friday that Sucic, asked after Croatia duty, said the picture would be clearer in two or three months.
